meaning_en: {var}={value} is not a token source; use one of: {allowed}
meaning_zh: {var}={value} 不是有效的令牌来源，请用其中之一：{allowed}

meaning_en: {prefix} tokens come only from a host command: set {var}=command and provide {command_var}
meaning_zh: {prefix} 的令牌只能由宿主命令提供：请设置 {var}=command 并提供 {command_var}

meaning_en: {var} is required when {source_var}=command (a command that prints one JSON object with access_token and expires_at); searched: {searched}
meaning_zh: {source_var}=command 时必须提供 {var}（一个输出单个 JSON 对象、含 access_token 和 expires_at 的命令）；已查找：{searched}

meaning_en: {var} is not a valid command line: {detail}
{var} exited with status {status}; its error output: {stderr} (its standard output is never shown: it may hold a token)
meaning_zh: {var} 以状态 {status} 退出；错误输出：{stderr}（标准输出从不显示，因为其中可能有令牌）

meaning_en: {var} did not print exactly one JSON object on its standard output
meaning_zh: {var} 没有在标准输出上打印恰好一个 JSON 对象

meaning_en: {source} gave a token that has already expired
{source}: expires_at {value} is neither epoch seconds (or milliseconds) nor an ISO 8601 time
meaning_zh: {source}：expires_at {value} 既不是纪元秒数（或毫秒数），也不是 ISO 8601 时间

meaning_en: {source} gave a token with no expires_at, and this API needs one: its tokens lapse, and a token with no known expiry would be reused until the API refuses it
meaning_zh: {source} 给出的令牌没有 expires_at，而这个接口需要：它的令牌会过期，没有已知过期时间的令牌会一直被重复使用，直到接口拒绝
